ud2.8:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kuṇḍiyāyaṃ viharati kuṇḍadhānavane
ud2.8:1.3: tena kho pana samayena suppavāsā koliyadhītā sattavassāni gabbhaṃ dhāreti
ud2.8:1.4: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā. sā dukkhāhi tibbāhi kharāhi kaṭukāhi vedanāhi phuṭṭhā tīhi vitakkehi adhivāseti:
ud2.8:1.5: “sammāsambuddho vata so bhagavā yo imassa evarūpassa dukkhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ deseti,
ud2.8:1.6: supaṭipanno vata tassa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yo imassa evarūpassa dukkhassa pahānāya paṭipanno.
ud2.8:1.7: susukhaṃ vata taṃ nibbānaṃ yatthidaṃ evarūpaṃ dukkhaṃ na saṃvijjatī”ti.
ud2.8:2.1: atha kho suppavāsā koliyadhītā sāmikaṃ āmantesi:
ud2.8:2.2: “ehi tvaṃ ayyaputta, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi. appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha:
ud2.8:2.3: “suppavāsā bhante koliyadhītā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati. appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī”ti.
ud2.8:2.6: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā. sā dukkhāhi tibbāhi kharāhi kaṭukāhi vedanāhi phuṭṭhā tīhi vitakkehi adhivāseti:
ud2.8:2.7: “sammāsambuddho vata so bhagavā, yo imassa evarūpassa dukkhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ deseti.
ud2.8:2.8: supaṭipanno vata tassa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yo imassa evarūpassa dukkhassa pahānāya paṭipanno.
ud2.8:2.9: susukhaṃ vata taṃ nibbānaṃ yatthidaṃ evarūpaṃ dukkhaṃ na saṃvijjatī”’ti.
ud2.8:3.1: paramanti kho so koliyaputto suppavāsāya koliyadhītāya paṭissuṇitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
ud2.8:3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho koliyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud2.8:3.3: “suppavāsā bhante koliyadhītā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatīti.
ud2.8:3.6: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā sā dukkhāhi tibbāhi kharāhi kaṭukāhi vedanāhi phuṭṭhā tīhi vitakkehi adhivāseti:
ud2.8:3.7: ‘sammāsambuddho vata so bhagavā, yo imassa evarūpassa dukkhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ deseti.
ud2.8:3.8: supaṭipanno vata tassa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yo imassa evarūpassa dukkhassa pahānāya paṭipanno.
ud2.8:3.9: susukhaṃ vata nibbānaṃ, yatthidaṃ evarūpaṃ dukkhaṃ na saṃvijjatī”ti.
ud2.8:4.1: “sukhinī hotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā arogā, arogaṃ puttaṃ vijāyatū”ti.
ud2.8:4.2: saha vacanā ca pana bhagavato suppavāsā koliyadhītā sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijāyi.
ud2.8:5.1: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho so koliyaputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena sakaṃ gharaṃ tena paccāyāsi.
ud2.8:5.2: addasā kho koliyaputto suppavāsaṃ koliyadhītaraṃ sukhiniṃ arogaṃ, arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātaṃ.
ud2.8:5.4: “acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā, yatra hi nāmāyaṃ suppavāsā koliyadhītā saha vacanā ca pana bhagavato sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijāyissatī”ti.
ud2.8:6.1: atha kho suppavāsā koliyadhītā sāmikaṃ āmantesi:
ud2.8:6.2: “ehi tvaṃ ayyaputta, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi,
ud2.8:6.3: suppavāsā bhante koliyadhītā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī”ti.
ud2.8:6.6: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā. sā etarahi sukhinī arogā, arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātā.
ud2.8:6.7: sā sattāhaṃ buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimanteti.
ud2.8:6.8: adhivāsetu kira bhante bhagavā suppavāsāya koliyadhītāya satta bhattāni saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
ud2.8:7.1: paramanti kho so koliyaputto suppavāsāya koliyadhītāya paṭissuṇitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
ud2.8:7.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so koliyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud2.8:8.1: “suppavāsā bhante koliyadhītā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati.
ud2.8:8.3: suppavāsā bhante koliyadhītā sattavassāni gabbhaṃ dhāresi.
ud2.8:8.4: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā. sā etarahi sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātā.
ud2.8:8.5: sā sattāhaṃ buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimanteti.
ud2.8:8.6: adhivāsetu kira bhante bhagavā suppavāsāya koliyadhītāya satta bhattāni saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
ud2.8:9.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena upāsakena buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṅgho svātanāya bhattena nimantito hoti.
ud2.8:9.2: so ca upāsako āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
ud2.8:9.3: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ āmantesi:
ud2.8:9.4: “ehi tvaṃ moggallāna, yena so upāsako tenupasaṅkameyyāsi: upasaṅkamitvā taṃ upāsakaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
ud2.8:9.6: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā. sā etarahi sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātā.
ud2.8:9.7: sā sattāhaṃ buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimanteti.
ud2.8:9.8: karotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā sattabhattāni. pacchā tvaṃ karissati.
ud2.8:10.1: evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavato paṭissuṇitvā yena so upāsako, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ upāsakaṃ etadavoca:
ud2.8:10.3: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā sā etarahi sukhinī, arogā, arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātā.
ud2.8:10.5: karotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā sattabhattāni, pacchā tvaṃ karissasī”ti.
ud2.8:11.1: “sace me bhante ayyo mahāmoggallāno tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pāṭibhogo
ud2.8:11.3: karotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā sattabhattāni. pacchā ahaṃ karissāmī”ti.
ud2.8:11.4: “dvinnaṃ kho te ahaṃ āvuso dhammānaṃ pāṭibhogo
ud2.8:12.1: “sace me bhante, ayyo mahāmoggallāno dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ pāṭibhogo
ud2.8:12.3: karotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā sattabhattāni. pacchā ahaṃ karissāmī”ti.
ud2.8:13.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ upāsakaṃ saññāpetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud2.8:13.3: karotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā sattabhattāni, pacchā so karissatī”ti.
ud2.8:14.1: atha kho suppavāsā koliyadhītā sattāhaṃ buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi, sampavāresi.
ud2.8:14.2: tañca dārakaṃ bhagavantaṃ vandāpesi, sabbañca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ.
ud2.8:15.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto taṃ dārakaṃ etadavoca:
ud2.8:15.2: “kacci te dāraka, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci na kiñci dukkha”nti.
ud2.8:15.3: “kuto me bhante sāriputta, khamanīyaṃ. kuto yāpanīya.
ud2.8:16.2: “putto me dhammasenāpatinā saddhiṃ mantetī”ti, attamanā pamuditā pītisomanassajātā ahosi.
ud2.8:16.3: atha kho bhagavā (suppavāsaṃ koliyadhītaraṃ attamanaṃ pamuditaṃ pītisomanassajātaṃ disvā suppavāsaṃ koliyadhītaraṃ etadavoca:
ud2.8:17.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
